knowledge.name: Synthetic huddle board snapshot
knowledge.detail: Nine fictional issues across four lanes with unit, category, status, owner, originator, waiting-on, and hours in tier.

knowledge.name: Tier configuration
knowledge.detail: Tier 1 through Executive with the huddle time and the 8, 24, 48, and 72 hour targets each tier must meet.

knowledge.name: Paging roster
knowledge.detail: Fictional people and roles to page in Microsoft Teams for each tier, chosen by issue category.

knowledge.name: Guardrail and closure rules
knowledge.detail: Routing, evidence, hold-period, and no-write rules, including that mitigated is not closed.

intelligence_processing.name: Tier clock calculation
intelligence_processing.detail: Subtracts hours in tier from the tier target and flags past-target items; mitigated items run a hold clock instead.

intelligence_processing.name: Waiting-on-me filter
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists the open items waiting on the person asking, defaulting to the 4 West nurse manager.

intelligence_processing.name: Escalation draft builder
intelligence_processing.detail: Moves an issue up one tier on paper, restarts the clock at the new target, writes the reason, and picks who to page.

intelligence_processing.name: Closure gate
intelligence_processing.detail: Keeps a mitigated issue open until its hold period ends and the person who raised it confirms the fix held.

intelligence_processing.name: Leadership decision queue
intelligence_processing.detail: Collects items that need a leadership decision, most urgent clock first, with each item's reason.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio huddle assistant
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file TieredHuddleBoardAgent locally with deterministic routing over the board snapshot.

clients_user_interface.name: Nurse manager between patients
clients_user_interface.detail: Answers lead with what is past target and waiting on the person asking, in one screen.

management_reporting.name: Whole board view
management_reporting.detail: Every lane, item, clock, status, and waiting-on, with the most urgent past-target item first.

management_reporting.name: Leadership huddle agenda
management_reporting.detail: Each decision needed today with its lane, reason, clock, and owner, plus past-target items for awareness.

management_reporting.name: Huddle acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Four locked nurse manager and chief nursing officer cases, one per operation, with exact anchors.

tools.name: Portable TieredHuddleBoardAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with four deterministic read-only operations over synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill package; publishing stays with an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Microsoft Dataverse
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for the issue, tier, clock, and paging roster tables; synthetic records stand in.

tools.name: Power Apps huddle board
tools.detail: The board where the issue owner confirms an escalation and the originator confirms a closure.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Carries escalation pages only after a person confirms; the agent never sends one.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic hospital evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every unit, issue, person, role, ticket, and clock is invented; the board carries no patient data.

supporting_features.name: No escalation, page, or closure
supporting_features.detail: Never moves an issue between tiers, restarts a clock, pages anyone, closes an issue, or records a decision.

supporting_features.name: One-confirmation escalation
supporting_features.detail: The issue owner confirms each escalation on the board before the tier changes and the pages go out.

supporting_features.name: Four routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Board view, escalation draft, closure check, and leadership decisions each answer one bounded question.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
